title: “The Freshmen” by The Verve Pipe
text: "The Freshmen" is a song by American alternative rock band the Verve Pipe. Released in January 1997 as the third single from their second studio album Villains, the song became the band's breakthrough hit and is the group's highest-charting single, peaking at number five on the US Billboard Hot 100, number six in Canada, and number 28 in Australia.

title: “I Want You” by Savage Garden
text: "I Want You" is a song by Australian pop duo Savage Garden, originally released in Australia on 27 May 1996 by label Roadshow as the lead single from their debut album, Savage Garden. The single reached number one in Canada and peaked at number four in Australia and on the US Billboard Hot 100.
